from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe.py')
s = p.read_text()
needle = 'TRAIN_SCENARIOS_PER_FAMILY = 8'
if needle not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected Stage 14G scenario-count constant not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle, 'TRAIN_SCENARIOS_PER_FAMILY = 6', 1))
PY
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile /tmp/stage14d-residual-intervention-audit.py /tmp/stage14f-per-output-residual-ablation.py /tmp/stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe.py; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python /tmp/stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe.py; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
